$comment: The stable data-testid / stable-attribute contract for design-conformance surfaces (cinatra#985, extended by the seeded data-contract wave cinatra#986). Each covered manifest surface maps to the REAL component file(s) that implement it and the attribute literals that MUST be present in that source (scripts/design/check-conformance-testids.mjs turns a missing id into a CI red). Renaming any of these attributes is a BREAKING change to the functional-acceptance suite by design — update the contract, the drivers (contract.ts), and the harness in the same PR. Selector notes document how the suite locates each surface at runtime; harness instrumentation attributes (data-surface-id, data-variant, data-tab, data-installed-version) live on the conformance fixture routes, everything else on real component code.

review-target-in-thread.selector: [data-surface-id="review-target-in-thread"][data-variant="populated"] [data-conformance-id="review-target-header"] — the REAL inert target header the review card draws above the island, mounted on the conformance harness route inside a chat-thread host declaration. The `name` field is the TYPE's display label, carried both as the value of [data-review-target-type] and as that element's text; the artifact's own title and type id are published on the harness root as data-review-target-title / data-review-target-object-type so the driver names a source of truth rather than whatever the header rendered, and the fixture's title and type label share no token. The two other readings are their own variants: data-variant="loading" draws the shipped [data-conformance-id="review-gate-loading"] skeleton, and data-variant="error" draws §IV's "no longer open" panel [data-conformance-id="review-gate-blocked"][data-blocked-reason] with its refresh back to the live gate.

review-states-outside-chat.selector: [data-surface-id="review-states-outside-chat"][data-variant="populated"] — the SAME review readings as review-target-in-thread, mounted inside a page-gate-region host declaration instead of a chat-thread one, which is §XIII.1's whole claim (nothing moves but the frame). state kind:artifact is read off the header's mono line: the artifact's own type id plus the revision the gate PINNED, carried as [data-review-target-revision], with the pinned marker on it. The manifest's continue-review action is on this wave's surface-readiness list (cinatra#3100).

run-progress-placeholder-in-thread.selector: [data-surface-id="run-progress-placeholder-in-thread"][data-variant="populated"] [data-conformance-id="review-gate-placeholder"] — the REAL placeholder the run card draws before the output has been generated. It has one reading and that reading IS the loading one: role="status", aria-busy, the card's own fixed name and the design system's spinning arc. The driver grades the absences the drawing fixes as hard as the presences — no status word, no result, and nothing to press.

reader-state-matrix.selector: [data-surface-id="reader-state-matrix"][data-variant="populated"] [data-reader-state] — §IX's two MOUNTED reader readings, produced by handing the shipped chip row the two different inputs the review card itself hands it (`onToggleMark` exactly when the reader may decide): a mark handler (live, a real press target) and no mark handler (read-only — plain elements with no press target and the component's own reason sentence). Restricted is never drawn as a disabled card. The matrix's third row — a reader who may not read the target — is on the wave's surface-readiness list: that absence is decided inside the review card behind an authorized resolve, and an empty suggestion set is not a stand-in for it.

literals: Deciding these needs approve access on this run.

extension-install-panel.selector: [data-testid="extension-install-panel"] (install-face root; the card's body swapped in place — access-target kinds only, never a dialog). Name field: the header band's [data-slot="extension-card-name"], carried over unchanged from the idle face. Opened from [data-testid="extension-install-panel-open"]; close ✕ [data-testid="extension-install-panel-close"]; body [data-testid="extension-install-panel-body"][data-availability]; picker [data-testid="extension-install-panel-picker"]; cancel [data-testid="extension-install-panel-cancel"]; submit [data-testid="extension-install-panel-submit"] (busy: [data-pending] — the `loading` state variant of extension-listing-card-installing, an ARTIFACT, is driven here); hidden failure mirror [data-testid="extension-install-panel-error"][role="alert"]

installed-extensions-filter.selector: combobox [aria-label="Filter installed extensions by state"] (URL-driven ?tab= server filter: all|active|locked|archived, cinatra#1571)

installed-extensions-status-views.selector: harness [data-surface-id="installed-extensions-status-views"] — wraps the SAME installed-extensions-filter combobox + installed-extensions-list pairing; asserts the §III.3 four-view (All/Active/Locked/Archived) status-filter contract those two surfaces already implement (default Active landing, option order, the dedicated Locked view, the All union), cinatra#1571.

install-config-needs-callout.selector: [data-slot="install-config-needs-callout"] (the §VI needs-review strip on the InstalledExtensionCard); name field + configure affordance: the connector link [data-field="manifest.displayName"] deep-linked to /connectors/<vendor>/<slug>/setup; empty variant: the strip is absent from the active card

extension-detail-modal.selector: role=dialog; name: [data-slot="marketplace-modal-name"]; kind byline: [data-slot="marketplace-modal-kind"]; details-only (cinatra#2406 removed the modal footer)

connector-grid.selector: [data-testid="connectors-grid-list"] holding [data-testid="connector-card"][data-connector-slug] (connected state: [data-connected]; name: [data-slot="connector-card-name"]; badge: [data-testid="connector-badge"]). The list CONTAINER is part of the contract since cinatra#2355: the All+0 panel REPLACES it, and "replaced" is only assertable if the container can be named.

connector-connection-filter.selector: toggle group [aria-label="Filter by connection state"] — THREE segments since cinatra#2355/#2357 (values all | connected | available, labels All · Connected · Disconnected, All first and selected on arrival). Segments are located by accessible name with exact matching, so the visible labels are part of the contract.

connector-install-cta.selector: [data-conformance-id="connector-install-cta"] — the page's closing "Install more connectors" button (design-system Button, data-variant="outline" data-size="sm", rendered `asChild` over a next/link anchor so the conformance id lands on the link itself). Also carries [data-testid="connectors-install-cta"].

connector-empty-panel.selector: [data-conformance-id="connector-empty-panel"][data-state="empty"] — the All+0 panel that REPLACES the grid, carrying the single install CTA (its own button carries the action but no conformance id, exactly as the spec's own markup does). Also carries [data-testid="connectors-empty-panel"]; the sibling Connected+0 panel is [data-testid="connectors-connected-empty-panel"].

connector-setup.selector: [data-conformance-id="connector-setup"][data-state] — the §II two-column setup body. Fields bind by their CONFIG KEY (input[name="<key>"], e.g. config.apiKey → name="apiKey"); connect/disconnect: [data-testid="connector-connect"] / [data-testid="connector-disconnect"] (+ [data-testid="connector-disconnect-confirm"] in the confirm dialog); the form's live connected state: [data-testid="schema-config-form"][data-connected]; right-column card: [data-testid="connector-status-probe-card"] over [data-slot="connection-status-badge"][data-status]; non-ready variants: [data-slot="connector-setup-loading"] / [data-slot="connector-setup-error"].

connector-config-tab.selector: [data-conformance-id="connector-config-tab"][data-state] — a custom config tab's Narrow-width (576px) panel. Fields bind by their CONFIG KEY (input[name="<key>"]); non-ready variants: [data-slot="connector-config-tab-loading"] / [data-slot="connector-config-tab-error"].

connector-multi-setup.selector: [data-conformance-id="connector-multi-setup"][data-state] — the Setup tab of a many-connections connector (same two-column body as connector-setup). Roll-up card: [data-slot="connection-status-card"][data-variant="multi"]; the control opening the Connections tab: [data-testid="connector-view-connections"].

connector-connections.selector: [data-conformance-id="connector-connections"][data-state] — the Connections tab; one stacked card per connection ([data-slot="connection-row"][data-status]) each carrying [data-slot="connection-status-badge"][data-status].

scheduling-step-configured.selector: harness [data-surface-id="scheduling-step-configured"][data-variant="populated"] (Save changes → data-outcome="rearmed"; Cancel schedule → one-step confirm → data-outcome="stopped"; error: [data-slot="alert"]; loading: [data-testid="scheduling-step-configured-loading"]). REPLACES scheduling-trigger-tab, retired by the manifest this pin adopted; the two operations are the ones the shipped schedule card draws.

sidebar-assistants-entry.selector: harness [data-surface-id="sidebar-assistants-entry"][data-variant="populated"] (the entry → data-outcome="assistants"). The REAL entry is app-sidebar.tsx's AssistantsNavItem, whose literals below are the §IX conformance contract and are additionally asserted at the source by src/components/__tests__/sidebar-assistants-conformance.test.ts.

breadcrumb-entity-resolution.selector: harness [data-surface-id="breadcrumb-entity-resolution"][data-variant="populated"] (resolved trail [data-testid="crumb-label"], unresolved trail [data-testid="crumb-placeholder"], each read at its last [data-slot="breadcrumb-page"]; the "Visit an unauthorized page" control mounts the real CrumbContributionsClear island → data-outcome="resolved-names-cleared"; loading: [data-surface-id="breadcrumb-entity-resolution"][data-variant="loading"] [data-testid="crumb-placeholder-loading"], asserted on its crumb text). The mount DRIVES the real resolution road (the contributions bus + the trail builder + the real clear island + the real Breadcrumb primitives) rather than modelling it.

notifications-list.selector: harness [data-surface-id="notifications-list"][data-variant="populated"] (title field: [data-field="item.title"]; decide-approval -> data-outcome="decided"; empty/error/loading variants). Real surface: the [data-conformance-id="notifications-list"] list + the notifications-skeletons loading rows.

notifications-filters.selector: harness [data-surface-id="notifications-filters"][data-variant="populated"] (four chips All/Needs action/Unread/In progress; filter -> data-outcome="filtered"). Real surface: the [data-conformance-id="notifications-filters"] chip group.

notification-row.selector: harness [data-surface-id="notification-row"] (resting row carries the read-dot; loading variant = [data-slot="feed-row-skeleton"]). Real surface: the [data-conformance-id="notification-row"] row shell.

approval-row.selector: harness [data-surface-id="approval-row"] (eligibility pill; decide-approval -> data-outcome="decided"; loading = [data-slot="feed-row-skeleton"]). Real surface: the [data-conformance-id="approval-row"] row shell + its inline decide slot.

notifications-filter-rail.selector: harness [data-surface-id="notifications-filter-rail"][data-variant="loading"] (the real NotificationsFilterRailSkeleton — aria-busy labelled group, four chip-shaped [data-slot="skeleton"]).

notifications-bell.selector: harness [data-surface-id="notifications-bell"] (open -> navigated proven by the bell link href="/notifications"; loading = the real NotificationsBellSkeleton). Real surfaces: the NotificationsBellTrigger link + the exported bell-skeleton.

notifications-empty.selector: harness [data-surface-id="notifications-empty"][data-variant="empty"] (exactly "No notifications"). Real surface: the [data-conformance-id="notifications-empty"] universal empty state.

notifications-vendor-gate.selector: harness [data-surface-id="notifications-vendor-gate"][data-variant="empty"] (ABSENCE contract: the rendered [data-source-id] set is exactly the non-vendor set; neither vendor-gated source id appears). Real gate: the registered-vendor predicate the marketplace vendor sources gate their rows on.

notifications-degraded.selector: harness [data-surface-id="notifications-degraded"][data-variant="error"] (the single inline "some approvals are currently unavailable" line). Real surface: the [data-conformance-id="notifications-degraded"] degraded line.

suggestion-chip.selector: [data-surface-id={surface}] [data-conformance-id="suggestion-chips"][data-suggestion-chips-mode="live"] — the REAL SuggestionChips row, the shipped chip row of the one review renderer, mounted on the conformance harness route inside a chat-thread host declaration. ONE chip per suggestion, addressed by the state it is drawn in: [data-conformance-id="suggestion-accepted"] / "suggestion-dismissed", each carrying data-suggestion-state and, on that same row element, the MANIFEST'S OWN action name as data-action ("dismiss-suggestion -> dismissed" on an accepted chip, "accept-suggestion -> accepted" on a dismissed one); the press target is the button inside the row. The harness holds only the reader's LOCAL dismissal set, which is where a mark lives on a pending gate (§VIII gives the chips no submit of their own); the drawn state, the offered control and its name are computed by the shipped component, so nothing the driver asserts is named by the harness.

extension-listing-card.selector: [data-testid="extension-listing-card"] (idle-face root, carries data-kind); name field: [data-slot="extension-card-name"]; CTA: [data-testid="extension-card-cta"][data-cta-state]. The card's `install` action opens the in-card INSTALL FACE, whose own contract is the sibling `extension-install-panel` surface entry (access-target kinds only — the card swaps its body in place instead of opening a dialog).
